title: CastBot Update
subtitle: Faster Safari Authoring — Currency in One Step, Reset Safari & Player Claims

cards.title: Currency Drops in One Step
desc: Adding a Give / Remove Currency outcome used to take five
clicks across four screens. It is now a single popup: amount,
usage limit and when-it-runs, all in one place, then straight
back to the Action editor. Usage limit defaults to per-player.

cards.title: Reset Safari
desc: Finished testing and want a clean slate? Clear claimed idols,
opened chests, tester inventories and round state in one go.
Three scopes, a preview of exactly what will be wiped, and it
NEVER deletes your Actions, Items, Stores or Maps.

cards.title: Player Claims Everywhere
desc: The Player Claims screen now appears on every claimable
outcome, in every section — Opening, Pass and Fail alike.
It used to quietly vanish whenever an outcome had no usage
limit set, which made it look like Fail outcomes lacked it.

cards.title: Honest Currency Messages
desc: A -50 outcome against a player holding 10 took 10 but told
them it took 50. Players now see what actually happened, and
an outcome that removes currency finally says Remove Currency
rather than Give Currency throughout the editor.

cards.title: CastDock Button Visibility
desc: Ticked a button and it never showed up on the dock? An
explicit tick now wins over the tidiness rules that were
silently hiding it, and the setup screen flags any button
that genuinely cannot appear yet, with the reason.

cards.title: Sheets Import Guidance
desc: The Google Sheets importer now tells you up front that a
season needs a category before Apply will work — checked
against your real season, flagged on the screen, and written
into the generated script instead of failing halfway.

underHood: Simultaneous claims can no longer double-grant
